propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket omit supported library parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) because handwritten callable signatures and forwarding layer do not declare or pass them.
FastMCP derives JSON schemas and validation from the stale handwritten signatures, causing undeclared payload keys to be discarded before the adapter runs.
The MCP adapter independently forwards only close_class or assignee, so even schema-only changes would not expose the full parameter set to the library core.
Transition force and claim force must expose unified reason-bearing optional string parameters that delegate unchanged to the library, supporting both start-work and completion-close bypasses.
MCP caused_by must produce the same culprit edge as the library, and explicit ref must target and sign the requested commit rather than HEAD.
Absent force, missing required close_reason, and deprecated force_close must remain rejected; absent certification is the audit signal.
